rationale: The primary null held: “did not support the hypothesized advantage,” all primary statistics remained, and “Neither specification provides evidence” preserved the required no-evidence framing. However, “visible dashboards may shape documentation practices” became “visible dashboards shape documentation practices,” dropping the modal hedge “may” and strengthening the reporting-completeness interpretation without authorization. The reorganization and transition plan did not authorize that epistemic change. No forbidden move occurred because the null result, statistics, and no-evidence framing were retained without positive or near-significant reframing.
